management_commentary.sentence: Under the new guidance, we still expect full-year 2026 segment profit in dollars to be roughly the same, around $4.4 billion as per the prior guide.
We posted record revenue of $7.5 billion, along with Q1 record segment profit of $1.7 billion and margins of 22.7%.

And the reasons behind are, once again, twofold: One is the pricing already implemented; and two, we're going to get the leverage from the ramp-up investments that we have that's going to start improving our profits, improving our incremental here.
